Convert a spec to JSON or to a widget

Source: R/spec.R
as_json.Rd

Two ways out of a new_spec(). as_json() gives the ECharts option as a JSON string — hand it to a frontend, a tool call, or a file, and pass it straight to echarts.setOption(). as_widget() wraps it in an echarts4r htmlwidget for Shiny, R Markdown and Quarto.

Usage

as_json(x, pretty = FALSE, ...)

as_widget(x, height = NULL, width = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A mediaplanr_spec.

pretty

Whether to indent the JSON. Default FALSE, since the usual destination is a machine.

...

Unused.

height, width

Widget dimensions, passed to echarts4r::e_charts(). NULL fills the container.

Value

as_json() a JSON string; as_widget() an echarts4r htmlwidget.

Examples

p <- mediaplanr::media_plan_from_df(
  data.frame(week = as.Date("2026-07-06"), channel = c("TV", "Search"),
             planned_spend = c(80, 40)),
  grain = "channel", time = "week", name = "Q3"
)
substr(as_json(ec_tree(p)), 1, 60)
#> [1] "{\"textStyle\":{\"fontFamily\":\"IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, -apple"
